name.text: Determining the equation of a straight line.

questiontext.text:
Determine the equation of the straight line using the points A and B.

[[jsxgraph]] var board = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(divid, { axis: true, showCopyright: false, boundingbox: [-7,6,7,-6], keepaspectratio: true, grid:true }); var p1 = board.create('point', [{#x_A#},{#y_A#}],{name:'A',visible:true, fixed:true}); var p2 = board.create('point', [{#x_B#},{#y_B#}],{name:'B',visible:true, fixed:true}); var l2 = board.create('line', [p1, p2], { fixed: true, straightFirst: true, straightLast: true, strokeWidth: 2 }); [[/jsxgraph]]

generalfeedback.text:
Worked Solution

To determine the equation of a straight line:

Find the gradient \(m\) of the line using the given points A and B;

\(m = \frac{y_A - y_B}{x_A - x_B} = \frac{{{@y_A@} - {@y_B@}}}{{{@x_A@} - {@x_B@}}} = {@m_AB@}\)

You can choose any point A or B to calculate the equation of the line.

Taking point A({@x_A@},{@y_A@}), point(x,y) and the gradient {@m_AB@}, the equation of the line is:

\({@m_AB@}= \frac{y - {@y_A@}}{x - {@x_A@}}\)

\(y - {@y_A@} = {@m_AB@} \times (x - {@x_A@}) \)

\(y = {@y_A@} + {@m_AB@}\times x - {{@m_AB@} \times {@x_A@}}\)

\({@eqn_AB@}\)

Also, if you choose point A to calculate the equation of the line:

\({@m_AB@}= \frac{y - {@y_B@}}{x - {@x_B@}}\)

\(y - {@y_B@} = {@m_AB@} \times (x - {@x_B@}) \)

\(y = {@y_B@} + {@m_AB@} \times x - {{@m_AB@} \times {@x_B@}} \)

\({@eqn_AB@}\)
